Allow ROTOS to read Google Maps turns
To show Google Maps’ turns on ROTOS, allow notification access once (ROTOS only reads Google Maps’ navigation notification).
Navigate in Google Maps as usual. When it starts guiding, ROTOS builds the map around you and shows your position and every turn; when Google Maps stops, the ride ends.
Switch on “Connect to ROTOS” above, then navigate in Google Maps as usual: ROTOS follows by itself.
To set where you are going from here: in Google Maps tap a place → Share → ROTOS (or pick a recent one), then Start ride. With no place, ROTOS maps the area around you.
%1$s is %2$d km away: ROTOS maps the area around you; Google Maps guides the whole way.
Share a place from Google Maps first (place → Share → ROTOS)
%1$s is %2$d km away. ROTOS maps cover up to about %3$d km per ride: pick a closer place.

Clock, weather, battery and calls are on ROTOS now.

For the blue route line: in Google Maps tap your destination → Share → ROTOS. ROTOS starts the navigation for you.

Starting navigation in Google Maps directly also works, but then ROTOS shows only the map and turns (Google does not tell other apps the destination).
A place name, lat,lon, or share a place from Google Maps
1 Switch on Connect to ROTOS 2 In Google Maps tap your destination → Share → ROTOS 3 ROTOS draws Google\'s route, Google Maps navigates, ROTOS shows every turn
Map preview, as ROTOS will draw it
Caller at the bottom of ROTOS; A rejects and texts “I\'m riding right now, I\'ll call you back later”
No Google Maps key in this build: no routes or maps, only Google Maps\' turns. See android/README.md to add one.
Bluetooth is off. Turn it on to reach ROTOS.
Location is off. Turn it on for navigation.
No location fix yet. Step outside or check that location is on.
ROTOS stops at about half of Google\'s free tier, so you never pay.
Close to ROTOS\'s Google limit. At the cap ROTOS shows Google Maps\' turns without a new map.
Google limit reached: no new maps until it resets (turns still show on ROTOS).
